messages.text: What is the BIS standard for electric kettles?

### BIS Standard for Electric Kettles  

- **Standard:** **IS 302-2-15:2009**  
- **Scope:** Safety requirements for household appliances that heat liquids, such as electric kettles and water boilers, with a rated voltage ≤ 250 V.  
- **Key Points:**  
  - General construction and insulation requirements.  
  - Protection against electric shock, overheating, and fire hazards.  
  - Mandatory marking (e.g., ISI mark) and performance testing procedures.  

*Reference: IS 302-2-15:2009, “Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Appliances for Heating Liquids.”*

messages.text: I want to manufacture an electric kettle. What BIS requirements must my product satisfy under IS 302-2-15, what tests are required, and which laboratory can test it?

### 1. Core BIS Requirements (IS 302-2-15:2009 - General Requirements)

| Aspect | Mandatory Requirement |
|--------|------------------------|
| **Rated Voltage** | ≤ 250 V (single-phase) |
| **Construction & Materials** | Non-conductive, heat-resistant housing; corrosion-resistant contacts; no sharp edges |
| **Insulation** | Minimum creepage & clearance as per voltage class; double insulation for Class II designs |
| **Earthing / Protective-Earth** | If metal body - must be earthed and marked “earthed” |
| **Temperature Limits** | Surface temperature not to exceed 60 °C at 230 V (or 50 °C at 120 V) after 30 min continuous operation |
| **Over-heat / Boil-dry Protection** | Automatic shut-off when water level is low or kettle body exceeds safe temperature |
| **Marking & Documentation** | IS 302-2-15 logo, model, rated voltage, power, manufacturer details, user manual with safety instructions |
| **Electrical Safety** | Leakage current ≤ 0.75 mA (Class II) or ≤ 3 mA (earthed) under normal use |
| **Mechanical Strength** | Handles, lid, and spout must withstand a minimum of 10 kg static load without deformation |

### 2. Required Tests (as per the standard)

- **Dielectric Strength / Withstand Voltage** - 2 × rated voltage for 1 min (no breakdown).  
- **Earth Continuity & Leakage Current** - Measure under normal load conditions.  
- **Temperature Rise Test** - Operate at full load for 30 min; record surface temperature.  
- **Over-heat / Boil-dry Protection Test** - Simulate empty-kettle operation; verify automatic shut-off within 30 s.  
- **Mechanical Stability** - Load test on handle, lid, and spout (≥ 10 kg).  
- **Water-Ingress (IP) Test** - Verify protection against accidental splashing (minimum IPX3).  
- **Surge Immunity** - 250 V, 1 kV surge pulse per IEC 61000-4-5.  
- **EMC Emission** - Radiated and conducted emissions within limits of IEC 60335-2-15 (referenced by IS 302-2-15).  
- **Durability (Cycle Test)** - Minimum 500 on/off cycles; check for performance degradation.  

A full test report covering each item above is required for BIS certification.

### 3. Accredited Laboratories in India (NABL-listed)

| Lab | Location | Services Offered for IS 302-2-15 |
|-----|----------|---------------------------------|
| **BIS Central Testing Laboratory (CTL)** | New Delhi | Complete safety & EMC testing for household appliances |
| **Intertek

messages.text: What is BIS

### Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)

- **Statutory Body** - The national standards organization of India, established under the *Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016*.  
- **Core Functions**  
  - **Formulation & Publication** of Indian Standards (IS) for products, services, and systems.  
  - **Certification & Marking** (the ISI mark) to assure conformity to these standards.  
  - **Testing & Calibration** through its network of accredited labs.  
- **Key Roles**  
  - Protect consumer safety, health, and the environment.  
  - Promote quality, reliability, and competitiveness of Indian industry.  
  - Support trade by facilitating mutual recognition of standards.

Electric Kettle  

📘 APPLICABLE BIS STANDARD  
IS 302-2-15:2009  
Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Appliances for Heating Liquids (e.g., Electric Kettles, Water Boilers)  
Covers safety requirements for electric kettles with rated voltage not exceeding 250 V for household use.

📋 KEY REQUIREMENTS  
✓ Rated voltage ≤ 250 V and appropriate frequency compatibility.  
✓ Adequate insulation and protection against electric shock (dielectric strength, leakage current limits).  
✓ Over-temperature protection and automatic shut-off when water reaches boiling point or kettle is empty.  
✓ Mechanical stability of the body, handle, and lid to withstand normal handling and accidental drops.  
✓ Use of corrosion-resistant, food-grade materials for all parts in contact with water.  
✓ Proper grounding/earthing provisions and compliance with earthing resistance limits.

🧪 REQUIRED TESTING  
• Dielectric strength (high-voltage) test.  
• Leakage current measurement.  
• Temperature rise and over-temperature cut-off test.  
• Boiling performance and dry-run protection test.  
• Mechanical strength and impact test of body, handle, and lid.  
• Water ingress / splash resistance test.

🏭 LABORATORY  
Find BIS-recognized laboratories capable of testing against IS 302-2-15:2009, such as:  
- Central Electrical Testing Laboratory (CETL), New Delhi  
- Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) - Electrical Engineering Labs (various campuses)  
- SGS India - Electrical & Electronics Testing Division  
- Intertek India - Electrical Safety Lab  

📑 CERTIFICATION PATH  
1. Confirm IS 302-2-15:2009 is the applicable standard for your electric kettle.  
2. Verify if any additional QCO (Quality Control Order)

messages.text: what are the requirements of the moisturizer

Understood. I can help identify the relevant standard, testing requirements and BIS process.

🔍 **PRODUCT IDENTIFIED**  
Moisturizer (cosmetic skin-care product)  

📘 **APPLICABLE BIS STANDARD**  
*None - BIS does not currently issue ISI marks or certification for cosmetic products such as moisturizers.*  
Cosmetic products are regulated in India under the **Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940** and the **Rules made thereunder** (e.g., Schedule M III for cosmetics). BIS certification is not applicable.

📋 **KEY REQUIREMENTS** *(as per the Drugs & Cosmetics Act & Rules)*  
✓ Product must be manufactured in a licensed cosmetic manufacturing unit.  
✓ Ingredients must be permitted and listed in the approved schedule.  
✓ Labeling must include batch number, manufacturing/expiry dates, ingredient list, net weight, and manufacturer details.  
✓ Safety assessment (including skin-irritation, microbial limits, heavy-metal limits) must be performed and documented.  
✓ Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) as per Schedule M III must be followed.  
✓ Product must be notified to the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) before sale.  
✓ Claims on the label must be truthful and not misleading.

🧪 **REQUIRED TESTING** *(typical for cosmetics under the Act)*  
• Microbial limit test (total viable count, absence of pathogens).  
• Heavy-metal analysis (lead, arsenic, mercury, cadmium).  
• pH and viscosity measurement.  
• Stability testing (temperature, humidity, light).  
• Skin-irritation / sensitisation assessment (in-vitro or in-vivo).  
• Preservative efficacy test (if preservatives are used).

🏭 **LABORATORY**  
Identify a CDSCO-approved or NABL-accredited laboratory capable of performing cosmetic safety and quality tests (e.g., Indian Institute of Toxicology, National Institute of Nutrition, or private NABL-accredited labs).

📑 **CERTIFICATION PATH**  
1. Verify that the product falls under the Cosmetics category of the Drugs & Cosmetics

✓ Thermal safety - automatic shut-off when water boils or kettle is empty  
✓ Mechanical safety - stable base, secure lid, no sharp edges  
✓ Materials safety - corrosion-resistant, food-grade components  
✓ Marking & documentation - ISI mark, user manual, safety instructions  

🧪 REQUIRED TESTING  
• Dielectric strength test  
• Leakage current test  
• Temperature rise & thermal cut-off test  
• Mechanical stability & tip-over test  
• Water leakage & corrosion test  
• Electrical safety & insulation resistance test
